title: did you know cholesterol changes through a woman's cycle?

segments.text: As we all know, female health is far behind in the medical field. One in seven healthy women get misdiagnosed with high cholesterol just because they test in the first half of their cycle. Cholesterol varies by up to 19% across the cycle. That's something that the literature does know even though we don't have reference ranges for healthy cholesterol for women by cycle when you go get your blood tested. And the open question is what else changes in her cycle?

We don't know in the scientific community. We have theories, we have some things that we've shown that change, for example, glucose management we know changes, but we don't exactly have reference ranges in what happens to a female's biology. And I think that measuring female health is an avenue for a woman to become legible in the world.
